videos.title: The Chess Rating System That Predicts Everything
videos.author: SciShow
videos.description:
You might have heard of the Elo rating if you’re into chess. Or women’s football. Or competitive Pokémon. Or even… fabric inspection. So how can a rating system for chess be so universal? And, /mathematically/, what does it mean when your Elo is… ee-/low/? Let’s get into it.
